evidence.quote: This Subcontract is governed by the laws of the State of California.
evidence.rationale: Section 15.4 governing-law clause.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall retain five percent (5%) of the amount earned under each Application for Payment
evidence.rationale: Section 6.1 sets retainage at 5% = 500 bps.

release_condition.value: Final Completion of the Subcontract Work; and Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner

evidence.quote: Retainage held under this Subcontract will be released only after both of the following have occurred: - (a) Final Completion of the Subcontract Work; and - (b) Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner.
evidence.rationale: Section 6.2 states both conditions for release.

evidence.quote: Contractor shall release retainage to Subcontractor within ten (10) days after Final Completion of
evidence.rationale: Section 6.3 sets release within ten days after Final Completion and receipt of retention from Owner.

evidence.quote: With each Application for Payment, Subcontractor shall deliver a conditional waiver and release on progress payment, covering the amount requested, before Contractor makes the progress payment.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.1.

evidence.quote: After receiving each progress payment, Subcontractor shall deliver an unconditional waiver and release on progress payment covering the amount actually received.
evidence.rationale: Section 7.2.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor shall obtain and deliver to Contractor corresponding conditional and unconditional waivers and releases from each of its lower-tier subcontractors and material suppliers
evidence.rationale: Section 7.5.

evidence.quote: All waivers and releases furnished under this Subcontract must be on the statutory forms prescribed by California Civil Code Sections 8132, 8134, 8136, and 8138
evidence.rationale: Section 7.4 requires California statutory forms.

evidence.quote: Contractor may set off against any amount otherwise due to Subcontractor under this Subcontract the amount of any Backcharge.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.1.

evidence.quote: Contractor may withhold from any payment an amount sufficient to cover the cost of correcting Subcontract Work that is defective or does not conform to the Subcontract Documents.
evidence.rationale: Section 8.3.

evidence.quote: Contractor will not pay for materials or equipment stored off site, or for materials or equipment delivered to the site but not yet incorporated into the Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: Section 5.4 expressly excludes payment for stored materials, on or off site.

anomalies.description: The contract contains no clause stating when progress payments are due (no days after application, invoice, or Owner payment). Article 5 covers application content and rejection only. Payment timing for progress payments is undefined.
Release of retainage is conditioned on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner, so release depends on Owner payment.

evidence.quote: Retainage held under this Subcontract will be released only after both of the following have occurred
evidence.rationale: Release of retainage is conditioned on Contractor's receipt of retention from Owner, so release depends on Owner payment.

anomalies.description: The 10-day retainage release obligation is further subject to delivery of Article 7 waivers and to any Article 8 withholding.

evidence.quote: This obligation is subject to Subcontractor's delivery of the waivers and releases required by Article 7, and to any withholding permitted by Article 8.
evidence.rationale: The 10-day retainage release obligation is further subject to delivery of Article 7 waivers and to any Article 8 withholding.

anomalies.description: Contractor may withhold any amount Owner withholds from Contractor on account of the Subcontract Work. This passes Owner withholding through to Subcontractor.

evidence.rationale: Contractor may withhold any amount Owner withholds from Contractor on account of the Subcontract Work. This passes Owner withholding through to Subcontractor.

anomalies.description: The Backcharge definition is broad and includes costs resulting from any failure to perform. Setoff applies against any amount due under the Subcontract.

evidence.quote: costs resulting from Subcontractor's failure to perform any obligation under this Subcontract
evidence.rationale: The Backcharge definition is broad and includes costs resulting from any failure to perform. Setoff applies against any amount due under the Subcontract.

anomalies.description: Recovery on change claims involving Owner is limited to the adjustment Owner grants, less Contractor markup and costs.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor's entitlement is limited to the adjustment Owner grants for the Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: Recovery on change claims involving Owner is limited to the adjustment Owner grants, less Contractor markup and costs.

anomalies.description: On Owner termination of the Prime Contract, Subcontractor's recovery is limited to what Contractor recovers from Owner.

evidence.quote: Subcontractor's recovery will be limited to the amount Contractor recovers from Owner on account of the Subcontract Work.
evidence.rationale: On Owner termination of the Prime Contract, Subcontractor's recovery is limited to what Contractor recovers from Owner.

anomalies.description: No payment for stored materials, either off site or delivered on site but not yet incorporated. This may affect billing for long-lead switchboard and lighting equipment.
